notes: Component macros are Subway's published amounts for a 6" sandwich (U.S. Nutrition Information PDF, October 2026); footlong builds use count 2. Sub recipes (bread, cheese, veggies, sauce) are the defaults shown on subway.com product pages, e.g. https://www.subway.com/en-us/restaurant/13583-0/menu/category/sandwiches. 'meatballs in marinara' is Subway's 'Meatballs' line, which includes the marinara; marinara is not published separately.
